taskDescription: Drag the correct pattern name into each blank.
textField: When ALT and AST are raised many times the upper limit with only a modest ALP rise, the pattern is *hepatocellular*; when ALP and GGT are disproportionately raised with conjugated hyperbilirubinaemia, the pattern is *cholestatic*; and when unconjugated bilirubin is raised with normal liver enzymes, the pattern is *haemolytic*.

overallFeedback.feedback: Hepatocellular injury releases ALT and AST from dying hepatocytes; cholestasis induces ALP synthesis and traps conjugated bilirubin; haemolysis overwhelms conjugation capacity, raising unconjugated bilirubin without affecting liver enzymes. Recognising the pattern directs imaging and further testing.
